headline: Clash Royale
title: Clash Royale Facts | Supercell Card Battles | Classic Games
video_script: Clash Royale is a mobile game from Supercell, the makers of Clash of Clans. It soft launched in January twenty sixteen and launched worldwide on March second, twenty sixteen. Matches last three minutes, and you destroy enemy towers using a deck of cards and an energy system. It became the top downloaded app on the US iOS store. Who is your best card? Comment below!
description: Clash Royale launched worldwide March 2, 2016 by Supercell. Sources: Wikipedia, Android Police.
joke: Three minutes is all it takes to lose your whole trophy road.
